items.title: Edison International (EIX) Stock Looks Cheap Even With Wildfire Risk
items.summary: Edison International stock has just absorbed a steep pullback, even though its longer term return profile and valuation checks still lean supportive. After the wildfire liability bill in California hit sentiment hard, the current pricing raises questions about whether investors are now overcompensating for legal and regulatory risk.
